_titleArtifacts_principle: S117 (2026-05-27): over-broad scraper selectors capture site chrome (filter-UI strings, header/logo text) as events. These are never real events. excludedTitlePatterns rejects known filter-UI substrings (whitespace/case-normalized, title only); rejectTitleEqualsVenue rejects a title that exactly equals its own venue name (the bare 'Onassis Stegi' homepage artifact). Both run at the save seam (scrape-all.ts saveEvents) so they protect ALL sources, and run before allowedKeywordsOverride so an override keyword cannot resurrect an artifact.
